notes: Primary key; must be unique and not null

transformation_rule: Cast to DATE (YYYY-MM-DD); invalid dates go to rejects with reason INVALID_DATE
Direct move; not in product master -> rejects with reason UNKNOWN_PRODUCT
One row per rejected source row with reject_reason, batch_id, load_ts
Blank -> quarantine (handbook S5); not loaded to silver
P -> Premium, S -> Standard, B -> Basic, ELSE -> Unassigned
New version: start = effective date; previous version end = new start and is_current = N; open end = 9999-12-31
Customer missing from feed -> is_active = N (soft delete)
Lookup on customer_id where is_current = Y; no match -> -1
